about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for the generator wiring added by rows 458/461 (night-1 triage class COV-WB-preset4-expectation, and its guide-layer sibling GD-WB-preset4, triage rank 7): tests/gauntlet/layers/coverage.py, tests/gauntlet/layers/scenarios.py and tests/gauntlet/layers/guide.py now call checkmap.wb_route_a_expect_for_hero/wb_route_a_tint_expect_for_hero so a case's Expect follows check_map.json's wb_route_a block instead of assuming every temperature-module write succeeds. Run by tests/intent/test_wb_route_a_generators_intent.py against the real generators (coverage.generate(), scenarios.generate(), guide.generate()), never a mock of any of them.
subject: tests/gauntlet/layers/coverage.py, tests/gauntlet/layers/scenarios.py, tests/gauntlet/layers/guide.py

examples.why: olympus IS calibrated, so before this fix the case expected an M4 rb edit to succeed; the corpus hero's preset 4 refuses it regardless of calibration (this was the 74-case wrong_refusal risk the triage flagged)
tint has no color-calibration reroute (wb_route_a_tint_expect_for_hero is unconditional on preset 4), unlike Kelvin/warmer/cooler which route through channelmixerrgb once pinned

fix round 1 (review I1): temperature.tint is vocab status absolute_only, so a RELATIVE tint move hits moves.gate(relative=True)'s ValueUnknown before refuse_wb_late ever runs -- on every preset, not just preset 4. Only the absolute darkroom_set (the example above) reaches refuse_wb_late; the pre-fix code wrongly routed this relative case to module_unavailable too, which would have scored wrong_refusal against every honest value_unknown reply in a live rerun

r0005 combines brighter (unaffected) with warmer (WB-refused); the case must stay an edit for brighter, never assert the M4 rb check warmer's own refused sub-move cannot produce, AND (fix round 1, review I5) explicitly assert warmer's own step refused (envelope ok==false plus its error code) so a live rerun cannot silently score verified while the requested warmth did nothing

night-1 triage rank 7 (GD-WB-preset4): the README/user-guide 'a touch warmer' example is a warmth move on the same corpus hero (preset 4) coverage/scenarios already route through wb_route_a; before this fix the walkthrough case expected a landed +150 K move that the guard refuses on every corpus frame, masking 8 cases (gd-06, gd-12, and 6 edu warmer/cooler) as failures once fix/n1-session-reopen lets the walkthrough actually reach them

the educative-level cases exercise the bare 'cooler' phrase directly (not a full sentence); the guide generator's own word-boundary match must catch this too, not only the README's 'a touch warmer' sentence
